definition: to rest and let your body go calm
description: A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

en.question: What is the woman in front doing?

de.answer: Sie liest im Wasser eine Zeitschrift.
de.question: Was macht die Frau vorne?

es.answer: Está leyendo una revista en el agua.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de delante?

fr.answer: Elle lit un magazine dans l'eau.
